spec.problem: The authenticated exercises screen had broken canonical review/progress storage and mismatched session contracts; the generator was absent and mixed Japanese/English examples produced invalid word-order prompts.

acceptance.text: GET /api/exercises/review/due returns HTTP 200 with the documented due-review list contract when empty and when due exercises exist.
Due review reads/writes use the canonical Prisma exercise schema and a PostgreSQL integration regression covers due, get-state, and upsert operations.
Visible authenticated /vi/exercises shows a helpful review empty state when no items are due and completes the practice journey with persisted daily progress.
Anonymous visits redirect to localized login; authenticated desktop and 390x844 screen states render without browser errors or horizontal overflow.

GET /api/exercises/daily-progress reads the canonical exercise sessions and profile goal, returns completed/goal/progress/isComplete, and fails with a logged 500 rather than fake zero progress on DB errors.

CSRF-protected POST /api/exercises/generate returns up to the requested number of persisted, canonical meaning-match questions from active lexemes without exposing correct answers; retries reuse the source-keyed cache.

Learner exercise sessions accept only existing same-type question IDs assigned at start; answer submission rejects unassigned questions, scores against persisted canonical exercises, returns feedback and totals, and increments daily progress after completion.

Visible authenticated learner can generate, answer and complete each available exercise type; mixed Japanese/English examples are excluded from word-order generation; daily progress persists after refresh, anonymous access redirects to localized login, and the 390x844 screen has no horizontal overflow.

POST /api/exercises/sessions rejects unsupported levels and placements with 400 before persistence; completing a session returns 409 until every assigned exercise has a saved answer, then persists exact totals.

spec.expected_behavior: The review queue is readable from canonical persisted exercise SRS rows; the setup screen and review affordance reflect real API responses, and learner practice stays functional.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible authenticated browser rendered /vi/exercises but GET /api/exercises/review/due?limit=50 returned 500; API log states relation learning.exercise_review_state does not exist. Prisma migration/schema place it in exercise.exercise_review_state.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the exercise-review query/test/baseline changes only; preserve the existing Prisma migration and canonical exercise data.
